title: PATCH /api/projects/:id/journal/:jid — update journal entry
description: Allow users to edit the title, body, and mood of an existing journal entry.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH requires auth and project ownership
Returns 404 if entry not found or soft-deleted

steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Find journal entry WHERE id = jid AND project_id = id AND deleted_at IS NULL. 3) Validate partial update. 4) Update entry + updated_at. 5) Return 200.
Update title — verify change and updated_at refreshed. Try with soft-deleted entry — expect 404.
